name.ja: 宮崎小林カントリークラブ コテージ

price.en: Golf stay pack with breakfast from 13,000 yen weekday / 16,000 yen weekend; with 2 meals from 15,200 / 18,200 yen. Room only with breakfast from 6,000 yen, with 2 meals from 8,200 yen.

description.ja: ゴルフ場の敷地内にあるコテージ18棟。1棟4名。1泊＋1ラウンド（昼食付）のパックと宿泊のみプラン。朝食付。
description.en: Eighteen cottages inside the golf course, sleeping four each. One-night, one-round package with lunch, or room-only. Breakfast included.
